name: Eurybates
fact: Largest member of the L4 Eurybates Trojan family — a collisional cluster of 64-km parent and ~280 smaller fragments. Lucy's 2027-08-12 encounter at 5.7 km/s will be the first close-up of a Jupiter Trojan ever, accompanied by Eurybates's 1-km moon Queta (discovered by Hubble in 2018).
bio: Named for the Greek herald of Odysseus (Iliad / Odyssey), discovered 1973. C-type spectrum implies a carbonaceous, primitive composition — Trojans are believed to be relict planetesimals captured into Jupiter's L4 / L5 Lagrange points during early solar-system migration, preserving compositional fingerprints of the outer protoplanetary disc.

links.l: Brown et al. (2021) — Queta discovery (Planetary Science Journal)
